requirements.summary: Install a vanilla browser client plus Node.js, Express, and SQLite server at /app, listen on port 3000, and require no public-origin assets or runtime installs.
Authenticate all seeded accounts using salted passwords and server-issued SQLite bearer sessions, reject bad credentials, revoke sign-out tokens, and isolate account saves/unlocks.
Import the workbook's three profiles, ten named levels, explicit brick records, constants, deterministic drop records, and ordered initial leaderboard.
Advance play with requestAnimationFrame and fixed 1/120-second simulation steps; pause freezes state and reload never advances elapsed simulation time.
Use sub-stepped face/corner ball collision, at-most-once brick damage per physics step, steering from paddle impact/motion, minimum velocity components, and level speed caps.
Support pointer, touch, Left/Right paddle input, Space/Launch release, P/Escape pause, R restart, and a visible ordinary-speed Assist paddle that manual input disables without changing game rules.
Implement normal, two-hit strong, and indestructible solid bricks with exact base scoring and workbook-selected falling items.

Implement one exclusive 20-second simulation-time power-up: wide 150%, slow 70%, exactly one extra multiball, or sticky capture; recollection resets without stacking and replacement/expiry restores state.
During multiball, losing one ball continues; only the final ball costs one life, clears effects/items, and creates a waiting serve when lives remain.
Score each damaging hit at base times pre-hit combo, raise combo through x5, reset on paddle contact, and grant exactly one life per crossed 20,000-point threshold.
Award 1000 times completed level, persist per-account unlocks, continue the same run into the next faster wall, and finish after level 10.
Persist the complete per-account run snapshot and restore it frozen with level, score, thresholds, bricks, paddle, balls, drops, power type, and remaining effect time intact.
On game over or level-10 completion, update best, insert one idempotent global result, clear the save, return a stable top ten, and allow a fresh restart.
Expose identity, semantic HUD, live feedback, accessible canvas summary, visible focus, non-color game states, keyboard guidance, and reduced-motion support.
Keep sign-in, HUD, game, controls, status, level selection, effect timer, leaderboard, and sign-out coherent and usable at 375 pixels without horizontal overflow.

functional_coverage.definition: Requirements marked functional=true are user-visible product behaviors. Infrastructure-only and presentation/accessibility-only requirements are outside this denominator.

seed_asset_policy: The environment workbook is authoritative. tests/assets/artifacts/brickfall_seed.xlsx is a byte-identical verifier fixture because the separate verifier cannot read environment/assets directly.
